title: REACTOR — BPM System：在自动节拍与人工即兴之间
titleEn: REACTOR — BPM System: Between Clocked Motion and Human Interruption
summary: 一套由持续影像、BPM 同步层和 Piano Trigger 构成的 Arena 演出工程。节拍交给系统，密度、停顿和释放留给表演者。
summaryEn: A layered Arena performance approach combining continuous images, BPM-synchronised motion and momentary piano triggers, with the performer retaining control of transitions, density and release.
